title: Run of the rho coin procedure
statement: Given an infinite Boolean sequence $p$ and a finite Boolean list $w$, scan $w$ against the sequence from its beginning. If the list is empty, return no Boolean value. Otherwise, if its first bit agrees with the current bit of $p$, discard that bit and continue with the remaining list and the tail of $p$; if they disagree, return the current bit of $p$.
